title: Buttons | Apple Developer Documentation - [Style](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/buttons\#Style)
claim: Avoid applying a similar color to button labels and content layer backgrounds.** If your app already has bright, colorful content in the content layer, prefer using the default monochromatic appearance of button labels. For more guidance, see [Liquid Glass color](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/color#Liquid-Glass-color).
supporting_text: **Avoid applying a similar color to button labels and content layer backgrounds.** If your app already has bright, colorful content in the content layer, prefer using the default monochromatic appearance of button labels. For more guidance, see [Liquid Glass color](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/color#Liquid-Glass-color).
